story.description:
Description:
As a QA Engineer, I want to validate the Football module in the Webook application to ensure users can seamlessly discover football events, view match details, select tickets, complete bookings, and access booking information with a reliable and user-friendly experience across supported devices and browsers. The Football section is part of Webook's sports event discovery and ticket booking experience.
Business Value:
Ensure a seamless football event discovery and booking journey.
Improve booking reliability and user experience.
Prevent functional regressions before production releases.
Validate integration between football events and the booking flow.
Scope:
Football event listing
Search and filtering
Event details
Ticket selection
Seat/category selection (where applicable)
Booking flow
Authentication scenarios
Payment redirection/confirmation
Booking confirmation
My Bookings
Error handling
Responsive behavior
Accessibility and usability validation
Out of Scope:
Backend API validation
Third-party payment gateway internal processing
Admin portal functionality
Performance and load testing
Security/Penetration testing
Acceptance Criteria
Football events are displayed correctly.
Users can discover football events using available filters and search.
Event details load accurately.
Users can select available tickets.
Booking flow completes successfully for valid scenarios.
Appropriate validations are displayed for invalid scenarios.
Booking confirmation is generated after successful booking.
Booked events appear in the user's booking history.
Navigation works correctly across the Football module.
UI is responsive across supported devices.
No critical functional defects are present.
